clips.title: 债券义警之父：利率4.5%是常态，经济真能扛住吗？

subtitles.en: We've lived with a lot. We've lived through a lot. Certainly since the pandemic, this market's got through a lot.
subtitles.zh: 我们经历了很多，尤其是在疫情之后，市场经历了很多。

subtitles.en: I recall a conversation I had with Bill Derby, the former New York Fed president, where early on coming out of the pandemic, he was talking about Fed funds that might need to get to 5%.
subtitles.zh: 我记得和前纽约联储主席比尔·达德利谈过，疫情初期他就说联邦基金利率可能需要达到5%。

subtitles.en: And at the time, it sounded absolutely crazy. Because if you said to anyone in this market, the Fed would take rates to 5%.
subtitles.zh: 当时听起来完全疯狂，因为如果你告诉市场美联储会把利率提高到5%，

subtitles.en: They would expect the economy, both the economy and the market, to crater.
subtitles.zh: 他们会预期经济和市场都会承压。

subtitles.en: And that didn't really happen. Do you think we can live with this?
subtitles.zh: 但那并没有真正发生。你觉得我们能承受这个吗？

subtitles.en: No, well, you might recall back in the early part of this decade, I was one of the few.
subtitles.zh: 不，你可能记得在本世纪初，我是少数几个……

subtitles.en: We said that we're experiencing the most widely anticipated recession of all times that isn't going to happen.
subtitles.zh: 我们说我们正在经历史上最被广泛预期的放缓，但它不会发生。

subtitles.en: It all speaks to the resilience of the economy, the consumer, capital spending.
subtitles.zh: 这都说明了经济、消费者和资本支出的韧性。

subtitles.en: Look, my view is I know I'm supposed to get all panicked here because I coined the phrase bond vigilantes.
subtitles.zh: 看，我知道我本该感到恐慌，因为我创造了“债券义警”这个词。

subtitles.en: And so I should get everybody all stirred up that they don't like what's going on.
subtitles.zh: 所以我应该让大家激动起来，因为他们不喜欢正在发生的事情。

subtitles.en: But I think 45% is kind of back to normal.
subtitles.zh: 但我认为4.5%算是回归常态。

subtitles.en: I'd really dislike that phrase that interest rates are going to stay higher for longer, because it implies that somehow or other,
subtitles.zh: 我不太喜欢“利率将长期维持高位”这种说法，因为它暗示我们应该回到更低的利率。

subtitles.en: we should be getting to lower interest rates. I think we're back to normal interest rates.
subtitles.zh: 我认为我们已回到正常利率水平。

subtitles.en: 45% is normal. I think it's a healthy sign of a healthy economy.
subtitles.zh: 4.5%是正常的，我认为这是经济健康的表现。

subtitles.en: It's a sign that the capital markets are properly allocating capital and the economy can deal with it just fine.
subtitles.zh: 这表明资本市场在合理配置资本，经济也能从容应对。
